extended_private_checks.scope: PRIVATE prepared-case structure; output omits patient and rule text
interpretation_limits: Action inclusion uses conservative normalized string identity, not clinical equivalence.
An answer absent from retained rule actions shows a surface mismatch, not memory causation.
An answer present in the retained rules does not prove the model followed those rules.
A/D semantic coherence and clinical reasonableness require independent clinician review.
Multiple actions in a branch may be valid alternatives, not logical contradictions.

classification_policy: 1/2 are normalized literal inclusion/absence. Categories 3 semantic equivalence and 4 unresolved mapping require review; no clinician labels inferred.
